title: SolarSwap
tagline: SolarSwap is a new decentralized exchange (DEX) that has forked from Uniswap and aims to be live on Filecoin. This platform offers fast, secure, and decentralized trading with low gas fees, this is an important building block.
description:
SolarSwap is a new decentralized exchange (DEX) forked from Uniswap and aims to live on Filecoin. This platform offers fast, secure, and decentralized trading with low gas fees, this is an important building block.
We had some trouble with the front-end part and are constantly dealing with errors
how_its_made:
This project was made by forking the Uniswap Router V2 and the Uniswap V2 Factory contracts. The Front end is composed of Next.js, Chakra.UI for the Styling and WAGMI for Smart Contracts communication.
We had a lot of trouble using WAGMI, as there aren't many resources online on how to use it properly.
